gates.question: Does the pack name its lane, authority path, basis posture, fallback order, and refusal posture?
If bytes moved from local-private capture into a portable/shared artifact, is there a projection receipt with class, reason, and stronger-reuse block?
If risky or decoder-unknown bytes were retained, does the quarantine receipt block normal semantic reuse and force later explanation onto a derived artifact?
Does any promoted/shared artifact declare currentness class and head warnings before it is described as current-active or frozen?
For unstable-derived reuse, is there an import-compatibility class describing whether Cargo/toolchain/decoder/schema drift was reviewed?
If a new class value or warning class is introduced, did taxonomy, schemas, examples, and scenario coverage change in the same revision?

If a stronger share/current/frozen/compatibility use depends on a waiver, is there an active waiver ledger entry with owner/reviewer identity, stronger requested use, weaker safe sentence, and expiry?
If an artifact is projected, derived, quarantined, promoted, or used as a head, does it carry a produced-by execution receipt and a lineage register entry linking it to its parents?
If same-scope artifacts compete without one reviewed winner, is there a contradiction packet naming contenders, precedence rule, review-queue hold status, and blocked stronger-use posture?

If stronger reuse depends on manual review, is there a review request naming the requested carry, consulted basis, and expected head, plus a decision witness before the stronger use is described as approved or resolved?

If stronger reuse depends on manual review, is there a review-separation receipt naming proposer/reviewer/executor identity, review-separation class, and compensating control when the reviewer is not an independent checker?

If manual review is being used to clear operational/current/public/frozen carry, do the request and witness stay bound to the exact reviewed head and fail closed into rereview/reissue when the lineage tip moves?
If taxonomy/schema/scenario/gate surfaces changed, do the machine-checked contract-hygiene checks still pass?
